description: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnet calculator: network, netmask, wildcard, broadcast, first/last usable host, total and usable addresses, block type. Optional split lists the smaller subnets (e.g. the /64s in a /48).

split.description: Optional: split into subnets of this prefix length, e.g. 26 or 64 (first 64 listed plus the total count)

name: subnet_calc
